Network Security

การสร้างโปรไฟล์ทราฟฟิกผิดปกติ

The identification and categorization of network traffic patterns that deviate from established baselines to detect potential threats, as described in NIST SP 800-94 and MITRE ATT&CK.

Quick answer: The identification and categorization of network traffic patterns that deviate from established baselines to detect potential threats, as described in NIST SP 800-94 and MITRE ATT&CK.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK and published by Protermify Cybersecurity as a static cybersecurity reference page.

Definition

The identification and categorization of network traffic patterns that deviate from established baselines to detect potential threats, as described in NIST SP 800-94 and MITRE ATT&CK.

Operational example

Anomalous traffic profiling allowed our SOC to detect unusual outbound connections, prompting an investigation into possible exfiltration.
